notes.title: RAM V1.0.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! Its been a fun couple of days seeing everyone's reaction to the final game as people make their way though the stages and story. Thanks once again to everyone that played the open beta and helped make the launch so smooth.[/p][p]That being said there were a few small issues that popped up over the last couple of days, so this patch addresses the majority of those issues:[/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new Epitaph Breakthrough Upgrade: Subcriticality, removes the juggle cap on orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Rally trickshot now scales linearly when stacked[/p][/*][*][p]Frame Interpolation now shortens the pre-sweetspot arc time of orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Stage 1 shop prices by ~20%[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented Shielded Enemies antiupgrade giving enemies swap shields during final boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted menu music to be the updated track from the OST[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Solidarity would be obtained multiple times[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Thistle and Epitaph skin unlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some Elite skins not displaying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Cuckoo memories not greying out[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some menu spacing issues with other languages[/p][/*][*][p]Many localization and typo fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Known Issues which will be addressed later this week/early next:[/p][list][*][p]Sol and Puukko can have an overlapping cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Ending can have layering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad Thistle issues[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to monitor bug reports and feedback so please keep them coming![/p]

notes.title: RAM 1.0 BETA PATCH V0.9.7
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, we are just over a week out from RAM's 1.0 launch! [/p][p]Thank you all for helping us work out the kinks. We've put a new build out on the public testing branch, and we would be super grateful if anyone testing could start a new save file to make sure the game works from the beginning, and all the sequencing works. [/p][p]The main thing still missing is beating the game on a Fresh File run, so don't expect that beating the final boss on your first run will make any sense right now. In fact, if possible when testing, please try to imagine what a first time player is experiencing so we can address the most common issues.[/p][p] Here are the changes and fixes since the last patch: [/p][p][b]Adjustments[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added new level 3 intro tease and slimmed down intro tutorial,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced starting dialogue amount when returning from the first run,[/p][/*][*][p]Turned off the combo system during the final boss,[/p][/*][*][p]More than one memory can now appear in a run (1 per Stage),[/p][/*][*][p]Solidarity now requires playing the Mail Sorting Minigame 3 times,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a re-read tutorial button to the Horde Mode menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 3 levels now display exit markers,[/p][/*][*][p]Added some failsafes for the final boss to avoid softlocks,[/p][/*][*][p]Ambush Tachis will no longer drain the combo meter,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Cuckoo reaction dialogue (no more dying after 23 floors),[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses are now invulnerable until the fight starts,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Regularization cost curve,[/p][/*][*][p]Rallying epitaph orbs now gives a trickshot bonus (RALLY x1.5),[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing irbs now work with pitching arm,[/p][/*][*][p]Killing multiple enemies with piercing laser now gives a trickshot bonus (LASER PIERCE x1.2),[/p][/*][*][p]Final boss now benefits from Open Source,[/p][/*][*][p]Memories can now be shared with Cuckoo after swapping with Ira,[/p][/*][*][p]Daily run upgrades now weighted for what bots can appear,[/p][/*][*][p]Stage 3 levels can now appear in daily runs,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Daily Run modifier generation,[/p][/*][*][p]Collider Decay no longer triggers during cutscenes,[/p][/*][*][p]Added German and Turkish Fan translation for testing[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could MITE as the hortitator,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where evo upgrades were applying to the daily run,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of issues with cynicism,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a conversation during the ending could be repeated,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Epitaphs would not revert skins after the player left them,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where exactly 500 fitness would not allow a reroll,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a second Cuckoo could appear in the curtain when in the shop,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where level 3 bots skins were not being reset when resetting save,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a dialogue portrait could get misaligned,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bounced bullets would disappear,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain memories would not grey out,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where open source would cause double stacking upgrades,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a pivotal cutscene could occur before completing the Thorn quests,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed layering and wall collision issues across a number of levels,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many typos and localization issues[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Ash Grove Update
notes.content:
Hello RAMmers!

It's finally time for RAM's second major early access milestone, The Ash Grove Update!
We've been hard at work on making the world feel more alive and making each run and time back in the hub feel more meaningful. This update caps off the planned content for Ash Grove and its residents, although more memories will be added over time.

Next up will be our 1.0 update later this year where you will get to experience the final area, the last two bots, and conclude the main story.

[h2][b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Ashen Citadel questline[/b][/h3]
    New Aphid minigame!
    Infiltrate the Aphid stronghold and smuggle contraband to a peculiar fugitive.
    Check the the fire escape in the large apartment building to the East of the river
[h3][b]Mysterious Tachi[/b][/h3]
    Rescue an odd character from Dojigiri’s fortress.
[h3][b]Router minigame[/b][/h3]
    We can’t really call this one a questline, but you can throw mail and stuff!
[h3][b]Steeltoe questline conclusion[/b][/h3]
    There’s finally more story to unlock by playing Horde Mode.
[h3][b]Memory system[/b][/h3]
    Find curious locations in runs and show them to Cuckoo (or others???)
[h3][b]Accessible Ash Grove 6 residences[/b][/h3]
    You can now break into almost every house in Ash Grove 6.
[h3][b]2 new skins[/b][/h3]
    One is hidden
[h3][b]New upgrades[/b][/h3]
    Unlocked via the new quests
[h3][b]Super Mysterious Uber-Upgrades[/b][/h3]
    These are complete placeholders for now. You get them from completing questlines.

This update also fixes several bugs and adds requested features like Save Resetting (which can be found under Gameplay settings when on the Main Menu).

As always, we are keen to hear your feedback and any bugs you may experience, so please consider joining our discord server if you haven't already: https://discord.gg/Rhp6vPCvgb

Thank you to everyone for the continued support!

- Xylem Studios

notes.title: The GOLEM Update
notes.content:
Attention all RAMheads! 
We are excited to bring you the first major update to Early Access!
Thank you all for the support and feedback over the past month and a half! This update addresses a lot of feedback, cleans up a lot of jank, and of course adds new content! Cloud Saving is now also available!

[b]New Content and Features:[/b]
Style Grade system
Complete a new storyline with the shopkeeper to unlock a system to grade your style!
Maintain higher grades to gain benefits for your hosts (move speed, damage, juice regen)

[b]New GOLEM Upgrades[/b]
Added "Haste" (creates explosion when swapping into host)
Added "Scorn" (create a temporary damage field between old and new hosts)
Added "Doubt" (swap back into old hosts during post-swap confusion to refund previous swap)
Replaced Myopia with "Hyperopia" (increases upgrade rarity, but never generates upgrades with the same type as the current host)
Removed Indulgence juice regen penalty
Hubris now doubles post-mortem swap cost instead of decreasing host HP
Obsession now changes all upgrades to a random host type instead of current host type
Euphoria slowdown now only affects enemies

[b]Fitness Gym[/b]
Practice a variety of trickshots to improve your skills

[b]Tachi Updates[/b]
Cancelling kill mode now reduces cooldown by 1 second instead of 2
Stabbing enemies now reduces CWBIDBSC cooldown by 0.75 seconds
Spinlock Meditation now increases cooldown reduction when stabbing enemies instead of decreasing base cooldown
Cancelling kill mode without using a CWBIDBSC gives a reduced cooldown depending on kill mode duration
Added a small fitness bonus for comboing CWBIDBSC kills
Added a new sound effect to indicate when kill mode cooldown is over
True Focus will now also target impaled fitness jammers

[b]Collider Updates[/b]
Tackling projectiles now adds them to your orbit 
Player-controlled colliders are immune to tar while tackling
Killing enemies with a tackle now awards x2 scrap and a BODIED trickshot
Secondary fire while retaliating now performs a mini-tackle that transitions fluidly back into retaliating (retaliation can now be buffered by holding primary fire)
Tackle cooldown now decreases faster while retaliating
Added recoil when retaliating

[b]New/updated upgrades[/b]
Added radical Collider upgrade “Entanglement”: +33% chance to shoot an additional projectile when a projectile is shot, -25% damage per extra shot
Reduced Spaghettification rarity to radical (as counterpart to Entanglement)
Added radical Collider upgrade “Decay”: Automatically fire +1 projectile per second at nearby enemies
Added breakthrough Collider upgrade “Beeftank Doctrine”: you’ll see :)
Added breakthrough Router upgrade “Perforated Envelope”: grenades fragment into +3 pieces on impact
Finesse now increases juggle combo cap and causes enemies launched after 3 or more juggles to explode
Careful Packing now extends grenade explosion timers by 0.1 seconds per stack

[b]Adjustments[/b]
Added Exit markers when clearing a level (can be turned off in the gameplay options)
Fitness Jammers now explode after being destroyed and play a sound effect
Added new sound effects for fishing to better capture the angling experience
Added new “run completed” sound when returning to Ash Grove 6
Adjusted certain doors in floors where a softlock could occur
Adjusted Press Rack placement to avoid quantum entanglement
Removed the Doors in the CPU Arena
Added Careful Packing synergy with Shaped Charges to effects description
Turrets can now be impaled by Tachi sabers, grappled, and emit sparks when attacked
The last remaining Heap orb will now revive itself after a few seconds to prevent softlocking

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed an issue where the upgrade selector was affecting the music volume
Fixed a bug where Heap Orbs would count as extra boss kills
Fixed a bug where dying as a Heap Orb would spawn the MITE out of bounds
Fixed a bug where the CPU could be pulled out of its arena with Yorikiri
Fixed an issue where the Bluescreen skin needed more kills than intended to unlock (now 8 as on the requirements text)
Fixed some issues with shop affordability not updating
Fixed an issue where the player could start a run while in conversation with Cuckoo
Fixed some issues with the starting host in Perimeter Defense not having AI
Harpoon tip no longer interacts with Heap Orbs
Fixed an issue with the MITE not updating the Variety multiplier
Fitness gain now can start immediately after beginning a run
Local Juice no longer regenerates when on the upgrade screen in combat
Fixed an issue where the Tachi time slow would not end correctly
Fixed an issue with rebinding the Eject key
Fixed certain audio not being on the correct bus
Fixed some visual layering issues
Decreased likelihood of True Focus clipping you out of bounds
Fixed an issue where True Focus sometimes couldn’t detect valid targets
Swapping out of a Tachi after starting a CWBIDBSC no longer causes the attack to miss
Fixed burning tar sometimes applying slowness for longer than intended
Alternative Coolant self-damage now bypasses post-swap invincibility
Reduced size of Alternative Coolant explosion when at extreme heat levels

notes.content:

notes.title: RAM V0.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch addresses most of the issues found on the first day. There are some issues we are still investigating and will fix asap, such as the cursor jittering on the map.
We have been reading the feedback and will continue to adjust things over the week! Thanks for a great first couple of days and all the positive reviews!

Adjustments:

Removed restrictions on fishing
Lowered the damage the Heap took from physics based attacks
Adjusted stack size font to be more legible on smaller resolutions
Adjusted doors in Staff Room and Coolant to avoid potential softlocks

Boss 2 Adjustments:

Heap orbs can no longer be possessed by the MITE until their shields are broken
Heap orbs no longer regenerate their shields after they break
Heap orbs now have healthbars after their shields are broken
Increased heap HP from 3000 to 3500
Decreased Heap orb HP from 500 to 400
Severing Heap orbs now deals 600 damage to the Heap instead of 500, but the damage no longer scales with modifiers like Deviance
Removed Heap's 50% weakness to physics damage
If Heap orbs are forced to drop enemies OOB, the enemies now die instantly
Changed Heap score to 1500, and orbs score value to 300 (previously they were all ~2000 due to a bug)
Damage from Efficiency no longer scales with modifierse like Deviance, and Efficiency now treats Heap orbs as bosses (doesn't instantly kill)
Fixed severing Heap orbs dealing negative damage to the Heap when at low health

Tachi Specific Fixes:

Fixed Tachi clipping OOB with True Focus (it should be less likely at least)
Fixed True Focus not targeting enemies standing too close to destructible objects
Free sabers no longer deal damage at low speeds
Killing enemies with sword stabs no longer gets the sword stuck mid-air until the enemy despawns
Decreased "ting" noise spam from free sabers

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where level 2 music was not looping
Fixed some Heap fight issues and softlocks (we are still investigating some edge cases for this and the CPU)
Fixed some issues with Achievements triggering (they should now trigger the next time the action occurs if missed the first time)
Fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the charging state after fishing
Fixed an issue where you could move with the Perimeter Defense Menu open
Fixed an issue where tutorial enemies could be replace with level 2 bots
Fixed an issue where EVL could be earned in practice mode
Fixed some visual layering issues
Fixed some typos and incorrect strings

notes.title: RAM wins Audience Choice at IGF2024!
notes.content:
Hello RAMheads,

We are absolutely thrilled to share that earlier this week, RAM: Random Access Mayhem won the Audience Choice award at the 2024 Independent Games Festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/0ff9607921e8e465434af2f6c8341567e7dba8b8.png[/img]

A massive thank you to everyone who voted for the game, we literally could not have done it without all your amazing support.

If anyone missed the event, you can watch the (very impromptu) acceptance speech here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eH67as6A7Og&t=3536s]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eH67as6A7Og&t=3536s[/url]

We are also excited to announce RAM is an official selection in the New Voices category of the London Games Festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/b6d4dcfde292f7e5ea41c4688e7783ccd102601d.png[/img]

Once again, thank you all so much for your support. It has been amazing to see RAM go from our little gamejam game, to being on the biggest stage in independent games. Our community is absolutely amazing and we are excited to deliver you more of the game later this year.

Thanks again <3

- Xylem Studios

notes.title: Development Update 3
notes.content:
Hello RAM enthusiasts!

We wanted to share a short development update on the progress of the game as we move into December.

In case you missed it, Devlog 3 was released, all about a new bot, the Collider! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/acb8cd31d81b4510eeb988dad09d8f5b29e9f331.png[/img]
Check it out here:
[previewyoutube=EB6c0xhf2vs;full][/previewyoutube]
Collider is one of the bots that will be released when RAM enters early access next year, along with another saber-wielding member of the post Patch world.

We are hard at work creating new levels and encounters, here is a small tease of what is to come:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/cb4f7c7f3f634e2bd08bb805421d4ec169402770.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/578dd01164d35f055313a157a7d9d9daa90d3310.png[/img]

In the new year we will have more to share about the story and world as well as the scope of early access, and we will be updating the demo to include the overhauled level 1 art. If you want more updates and teases on what we are cooking, come join our community discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Fr2ueDCeun]Xylem Studios Discord[/url]

We wish everyone a happy and safe holiday season, go destroy some robots in the demo to keep warm!

notes.title: Development Update 2
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow RAMheads!

In the months since the last development update we’ve been hard at work implementing an extensive list of new features, gameplay improvements, and visual overhauls. There’s simply too much to discuss in detail here, so this update will only cover a few special highlights.

Firstly, we are excited to announce the release a public RAM demo by the end of August! This demo will include the first of three planned levels, over 40 unique upgrades, and the four playable characters that were revealed in RAM’s first [url=https://youtu.be/7EpgjR-k3fE]Youtube devlog[/url]. A second devlog will be released alongside the demo to break down the new features in full detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/0a3bc4025c46580a42ac00545cd519fd30f7c3d7.png[/img]

Now to show off the new art for the other two announced characters, starting with the Flamebot - A.K.A. the "Aphid".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/379a959aadcd9cc7a3fcec247bc83bb14418f79c.gif[/img]

These little guys went through a few different design iterations, but we knew from the start that we wanted the Aphid to be a little crab/spider. Our amazing sprite artist penusbmic (creator of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317880/Bullet_Bunny/]Bullet Bunny[/url]) took our scattered concepts and coalesced them into this final sprite. Think of it as a walking explosive barrel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/1ad9e4ca02800885998d8488345a638b6ea5735c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/f6f334a3958da89b279bfc8e26878143dbcd2043.png[/img]

Everyone's favourite little gremlin, the Wheelbot, has also received its final visual design. They’re now known as "Routers". What’s inside the box? Even we’re not sure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/b3e73e1e8842f569c826a9de22df8e895e88abd5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/2adb9737b53fe4b80c53400f83e90df5fbcbed96.gif[/img]

Finally, an early look at the work-in-progress Level 1 boss sprites. Expect this large lad to end most of your runs until we get around to adding something even scarier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430504/f4e08506b47a482684a8a32d2941034ea0dd6ae4.gif[/img]

Thank you to everyone for your continued support. We are excited to finally get the demo into your hands in a few short weeks! In the mean time, we’ve set up a dedicated Xylem Discord server where you can follow the game’s development more closely and mingle with other RAM-minded individuals. Come say hi! https://discord.gg/rYZMgespCC
